description: One record per top-level category (大类). Categories are flat, not a fixed tree: they may be preset at the start of a research round or discovered when a cluster of intents fits no existing category. Source: 2026-11-23 bidirectional intent-category decision.

category_id.description: Globally unique category number, e.g. CAT-001

definition.description: Actionable definition: what belongs in this category, in the same wording annotators and Jev use

discovery.description: How this category came to be: preset before research, or discovered from a cluster of intents that fit no existing category

discovery_batch.description: Batch or round in which the category was created or first used

exclusion_criteria.description: What does not count as this category, with at least 1 boundary example

inclusion_criteria.description: What counts as this category, with at least 1 boundary example

name.description: One-line category name, e.g. 备餐管理

version.description: Definition change bumps the minor version; a category merge or split bumps the major version and leaves a change record

title: Category Entry
